# Analytics & UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Multi-Window Rolling Average Scale Targets

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality, mathematical completeness, and UI/UX consistency for 7D, 14D, 21D, and 28D scale targets in Pace & Linear Targets
**Created**: 2026-10-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact rolling window lengths (`7D`, `14D`, `21D`, `28D`) and their closed date intervals `[t - (N - 1), t]` and `[t - 2N + 1, t - N]` explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Is the removal of the redundant `DAILY WEIGH-IN` row inside `PACE & LINEAR TARGETS` explicitly documented while preserving `SameDayWeightTrioRow`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 Are the four row header titles (`7D ROLLING AVERAGE`, `14D ROLLING AVERAGE`, `21D ROLLING AVERAGE`, `28D ROLLING AVERAGE`) and their ordering explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Clarity & Mathematical Precision

- [x] CHK004 Is the formula for solving `Expected Today` scale weight (`round2((k_today + 1) * targetAvgTodayInUnit - sumPriorTodayInUnit)`) unambiguously specified for each `ND` window? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Is the formula for solving `Target Tomorrow` scale weight (`round2((k_tomorrow + 1) * targetAvgTomorrowInUnit - sumPriorTomorrowInUnit)`) unambiguously specified for each `ND` window? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK006 Is the anchor for each `ND` row's `targetAvgTodayInUnit` explicitly defined as `toUnit(priorNdAvgKg) + N * dailyRequiredRateInUnit`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Are display-unit conversion and 2-decimal `BigDecimal` `HALF_UP` rounding (`round2`, `diff2`) consistent across `Linear Today`, `Expected Today`, and `Target Tomorrow` in both `kg` and `lbs`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, §FR-004, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK008 Are container lifecycle precedence rules (`Unavailable -> GoalReached -> CycleEnded -> Available`) consistent with `ForecastBanner` and `MultiHorizonForecastState`? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Is the behavior specified when today (`t`) has no logged weigh-in (`deltaDisplay = null` for `Expected Today`, valid `Target Tomorrow` from remaining logs in `[t - (N - 2), t]`)? [Coverage, Spec §US1 Scenario 2, §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK010 Are horizon-specific fallback subtitles (`"Needs 7 days history"`, `"Needs 14 days history"`, `"Needs 21 days history"`, `"Needs 28 days history"`) vs `"Needs log from <d MMM>"` clearly distinguished based on `t - N < cycleStartDate`? [Edge Case, Spec §US3, §FR-003, §FR-006]

## Non-Functional & Accessibility Requirements

- [x] CHK011 Are responsive layout constraints (`360dp` viewport width at `130%` accessibility font scale with zero text clipping or visual overflow) measurable and specified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK012 Are merged TalkBack accessibility semantics (`resolveTargetCellContentDescription`) defined for all four horizon rows? [Completeness, Plan §Constitution Check IV]
